summary: Marcus confirmed he changed the inventory-service pool (USER-001, CFG-502: DB_POOL_MAX 20->80). That raised the orders-db connection budget to 610 against max 400. impact: Checkout errors from 14:03; 87 tickets by 14:30 against a normal ~5/hour (CUST-001). 14 customers report a card charge with no order confirmation (CUST-002). Search, browse and account pages are unaffected (CUST-004). Impact is in all regions (CUST-005).
